source.note: 9S18M3 target-detection radar: azimuth 360 deg, range 160 km at RCS 1-2 m2. The 9S36M with its 22 m mast detects 5 m-altitude cruise missiles out to ~70 km.

name: MIM-104 Patriot PAC-3
note: PAC-3 MSE-equipped Patriot battery: AN/MPQ-65/65A sector-scanning radar, six to eight launching stations, ~90 crew. Fires the hit-to-kill PAC-3 MSE (aircraft + terminal ballistic defence) and typically mixes in longer-range PAC-2 GEM-T (~150-160 km against aircraft). A new 360-degree LTAMDS radar is replacing the MPQ-65 series.

source.title: AN/MPQ-53/65 Radar | Missile Defense Advocacy Alliance
source.note: AN/MPQ-65 has 'a range of over 100 km'; the digitised MPQ-65A adds ~30%. Sector-scanning (not 360-degree) and horizon-limited at low altitude.

name: THAAD
note: Terminal High Altitude Area Defense: US terminal-phase ballistic missile defence. Uses the AN/TPY-2 X-band radar; a battery has six launchers of eight interceptors (48 rounds). Hit-to-kill, effective both inside and outside the atmosphere. Engages ballistic missiles, not aircraft.

source.note: AN/TPY-2 detects missiles at 870-3,000 km: up to ~3,000 km in forward-based cueing mode, ~870 km-class in terminal mode. Strongly dependent on target RCS and radar mode; the 3,000 km figure is a cueing sensor range, not a THAAD engagement range.

name: NASAMS

AN/MPQ-64 Sentinel radar, AIM-120 AMRAAM interceptor and Kongsberg Fire Distribution Center; a unit has three launchers of six missiles (18 ready), reloadable, radar and launchers can be dispersed >20 km apart. No ballistic-missile capability. Figures are for the AMRAAM/Sentinel baseline; the newer MPQ-64F1 radar (~120 km) and AMRAAM-ER extend the envelope.

name: Iron Dome
note: Israeli short-range counter-rocket, artillery and mortar (C-RAM) / counter-UAV system, the lowest tier of Israel's air defence. ELM-2084 MMR S-band AESA radar; a battery has three to four launchers, each holding up to 20 Tamir interceptors. Detects and engages to ~70 km; discriminates rockets that threaten populated areas from those falling harmlessly. Naval C-Dome variant exists.

source.note: 'Iron Dome can detect and engage targets at ranges of up to 70 km' (Raytheon / IHS Jane's). Optimised against short-range rockets, mortars and artillery.
